284373826.description:
C. Marsden Huggins
Portrait of an Elder Smoking a Pipe
Art Print on Paper
19" x 23" (Framed)
Signed in print lower left
This evocative portrait by Zimbabwean artist Cleta Marsden-Huggins depicts an African elder cupping his hands around a pipe. Active during the mid-20th century, Marsden-Huggins was celebrated for detailed figurative studies and African wildlife works. This piece showcases the artist's mastery of tonal shading and fine cross-hatching, capturing deep facial character, hands, and draped clothing with striking realistic presence.
Fine monochrome sketch-style print with detailed rendering and expressive texture
Features printed artist signature "C Marsden Huggins" at the lower left
Framed in a black wood frame with off-white mat and ready-to-hang wire on verso
Frame measures approximately 19" wide by 23" high
Condition:
Very good condition overall. The artwork is clean beneath the glass with mild age toning to paper. Frame exhibits minor cosmetic scuffs and edge wear consistent with handling, but remains structurally sound.

280945869.description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
